content_based.strengths: Zero cold-start for new items, highly interpretable explanations
content_based.weaknesses: Cannot capture cross-user serendipity without ratings

collaborative_filtering.strengths: Discovers latent taste clusters and cross-genre recommendations
collaborative_filtering.weaknesses: Cold-start for new users/items with few or zero ratings

hybrid.algorithm: Dynamic Weighted Ensemble (Content + SVD + Bayesian Quality)
hybrid.strengths: Best of both worlds: handles cold-start gracefully while providing serendipitous recommendations
